name: trendsagi-sdk-workspace
description: TrendsAGI JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs: core client plus OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK and Anthropic adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trendsagi/core && npm run build -w @trendsagi/openai && npm run build -w @trendsagi/langchain && npm run build -w @trendsagi/ai && npm run build -w @trendsagi/anthropic
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @trendsagi/core && npm run typecheck -w @trendsagi/core && npm run typecheck -w @trendsagi/openai && npm run typecheck -w @trendsagi/langchain && npm run typecheck -w @trendsagi/ai && npm run typecheck -w @trendsagi/anthropic
